# MH-02 — Define slot capacity

**Business value:** 995

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As an employee

I want to define the set of tables and seats available for each time slot

So that the hut does not accept more customers than it can serve


<!-- Manual clarifications below this line are preserved on regeneration. -->

## Clarifications

Slots are completely flexible in terms of starting time and duration.

The table list, i.e. table number and the reltaive number of seats can be reused from previous slots without having to re-enter it all the times.

A meal service on a given day might have more than one slot (E.g. 12-13 and 13:14)

Note that there is no concept of fixed table set you could have different set of tables and seats at lunch an dinner or on sunny or rainy days or ...
